title: Silver Inventory Spreadsheet Columns
takeaway: A well-structured spreadsheet includes key columns for tracking silver inventory.

data.label: Item ID
data.evidence: Consider a consistent naming convention, such as “SIL-RGP-100” (Silver Round, 100 oz) or “SIL-BAR-20” (Silver Bar, 20 oz).

data.label: Purchase Price (per oz)
data.evidence: Record this accurately, as it’s the basis for calculating profit margins.

data.label: Current Selling Price (per oz)
data.evidence: This will fluctuate with market conditions.

narration: The spreadsheet should be designed to be easily searchable and filterable. It requires a systematic approach to inventory management and includes columns for unique item identification, purchase details, and current selling prices.
